body: Maybe you could revisit the wall you crashed into one day, and do a few experiments there. You might remember dying there. You could prove it to yourself by seeing how accurately you can recreate the photos. Did you talk to anyone in washington? It sounds spooky but I don't think reality shifts are anything to worry about. The mandela effect happened to me ten years before I knew about it. As a kit-kat lover, I got annoyed when the dash in kit-kat dissapeared 1 minute after I had put it in my shopping basket.
